title: Self-reduction along a regular quotient
statement: Let φ:R→S be a coefficient-ring-sheaf map on the pro-etale site, and let f and p form a short exact unit sequence 0→R→R→Resφ(S)→0, where p sends one to one. For any S-module sheaf N, derived φ-extension of Resφ(N)[0] has cohomology N in degrees zero and minus one and zero elsewhere.

source.place: Order 1429, residue counterexample in (1); normalized tensor and periodic free resolutions, Stacks Tags 06YU and 0118.

proof.text: Tensor the normalized quotient sequence with the single restricted module. The generator acts by zero because p is the canonical quotient map on sections and fp=0. The normalized tensor triangle and long exact cohomology sequence identify both surviving cohomology objects. Local surjectivity of the coefficient map follows from the normalized unit epimorphism, hence restriction is full as well as exact and faithful; lift both isomorphisms to the quotient module category.

lean.statement:
theorem regularQuotient_single_cohomology
    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S)
    (f : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
      SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))
    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S)))
    (hp : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) = (1 : S.obj.obj U))
    (hz : f ≫ p = 0) (hs : (ShortComplex.mk f p hz).ShortExact)
    (N : pbcModules T S) :
    let K := (pbcDerivedExtend φ).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((pbcRestrict φ).obj N))
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0).obj K ≅ N) ∧
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (-1)).obj K ≅ N) ∧
    ∀ q : ℤ, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ -1 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)
